FULL TEXT:
MIZORAM PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
Mizoram New Capital Complex
Aizawl
N O T I F I C A T I O N
(LDE (Gazetted Post) No. 5 of 2025 – 2026)
Dated Aizawl, the 6th August 2025
No.A.34012/6/2024-MPSC (DR): Limited Departmental Examination for the under
mentioned post is to be conducted by the Mizoram Public Service Commission.
Application can be submitted through the Mizoram Public Service Commission’s
online portal https://mpsconline.mizoram.gov.in
Probable applicants who have not registered in the one-time-registration portal must
register latest by 4:00 pm on the last date of submission of application
An Applicant must verify that his/her application is actually submitted after payment
is made, otherwise the claim of the Applicants regarding his/her Candidature will not
be entertained.
1. Name of Department : Land Revenue & Settlement
2. Name of Post : Assistant Director of Survey/Assistant Survey Officer
3. Classification : Group ‘A’ (Gazetted)
4. No. of Vacancies : 2 (Two)
5. Pay : Level 10 of Pay Matrix
6. Relevant Rules : Mizoram Land Revenue & Settlement Department
(Group-A Post) Recruitment Rules, 2021.
7. Conditions of Eligibility : From officers holding the post of Surveyor-
I/Cartographer-I in the Department with 5 years of
regular service in the grade rendered after
appointment thereto on a regular basis.
8. Last Date of Application : 07-09-2025
9. Syllabus for the examination is available for download on the Commission’s
official website https://tinyurl.com/Syl-for-ads-aso-lde
10. Any additional information regarding this notification will be published on the
Commission’s official website.
Candidates can contact MPSC’s Helpline No. 0389-3596493 on working days
between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM for any information/clarification regarding their
applications, candidature etc.
Sd/- Dr.H.LIANZELA
Secretary
Mizoram Public Service Commission
Memo. No.A.34012/8/2024-MPSC (DR) Dated Aizawl, the 6th August, 2025
